sourceVisualNotes: Six actual inventory icons viewed: layered pink floral crown/ornament; horizontal ivory bone with red central tie; orange pumpkin bag; diamond three-disc licensed silhouette; round gold sun shield; pink faceted princess coronet. Item4685 deliberately becomes our original DIAMOND GOURD hairpin, not the licensed three-disc mouse silhouette. Source names/descriptions remain solely in catalog fields, while own display names identify the new designs.

items.name: pink-flower-crown
items.designBrief: One compact PINK floral crown hair ornament: three layered rose blossoms arranged in an ascending crescent cluster with pink translucent leaves and a small curved warmgold/jade band behind. Soft rose/paleivory petals, fine gold stamens, no head/person or halo. Keep the compact asymmetrical flower-cluster silhouette, not a generic metal crown.

items.name: ivory-bone-ribbon
items.designBrief: One horizontal cute IVORY BONE hairpin, two rounded lobes at each end and narrow center shaft, thin red silk tie wrapped around its exact middle with a small jade bead. Whole bone, smooth ceramic material, no skull, no extra bones or background.

items.name: pumpkin-silk-handbag
items.designBrief: One plump ORANGE pumpkin handbag, clear ribbed round body, small curved green vine handle at top, tiny jade leaves and fine gold trim. Original simple friendly jack-o-lantern face: two triangular eyes and one curved smiling mouth, no character likeness. Full handle and bottom visible, no candle glow or background.

items.name: diamond-gourd-hairpin
items.designBrief: One original DIAMOND GOURD hairpin: vertically joined smaller upper pear-lobe and larger lower rounded lobe, faceted icyblue/ivory crystals in a thin warmgold setting, tiny jade side leaf and a slim gold pin behind. Exactly TWO unequal gourd lobes, NO three-disc mouse head silhouette or ears, no face/licensed identity. Entire clasp complete, no starbursts or glow outside object.

items.name: gold-cloud-sun-shield
items.designBrief: One ROUND gold sun shield, central jade/ivory gourd medallion with concentric rings and twelve short broad triangular gold sun teeth around rim. Symmetrical circular shield, crisp engraved cloud motifs, small silver facets in ring. Not a face or external halo, no text or thin projecting rays beyond teeth.

items.name: pink-diamond-princess-coronet
items.designBrief: One elegant PINK faceted diamond coronet: THREE main pointed peaks, taller center, lower sides, small side diamond accents. Paleivory/rose crystals in thin warmgold bands, open transparent lower headopening, tiny central jade gem. Distinct geometric crystal crown, no person/face/halo, all peaks inside cell.
